_comment: Template for server/private/viewers.json, which is gitignored because it
holds real client email addresses. Copy this file to
server/private/viewers.json on the server and edit it by hand.
Each key is the URL slug: this entry is served at
title    shown in the header and in the OTP email
file     filename inside server/private/. Never served statically;
only ever streamed by an authenticated session.
allow    exact email addresses permitted. Case-insensitive.
There is no wildcard or domain match, deliberately.
expires  YYYY-MM-DD. After this date the document behaves exactly
as though it does not exist - the page 404s.
Changes take effect immediately; no restart is needed.
Delete this _comment key in the real file.
